commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
90+5' David Lopez (Girona) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
90+4' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Dodi Lukebakio and he is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
90+3' Substitution. Djibril Sow leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla).
90+3' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
90+1' Ivan Martin (Girona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
90+1' The attendance is 12040.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Michel prepares a substitution. Bryan Gil is replaced by Portu (Girona).

88' 1 - 2 Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Paulo Gazzaniga is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:2.
84' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' A substitution has been made. Isaac Romero goes off and Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) comes on.
82' Kike Salas (Sevilla) connects with a pin-point cross but produces a poor effort that goes well wide of the left post. His shot wasn't accurate, nor powerful enough.
81' Half-chance! Donny van de Beek (Girona) plays a pass into the box, but Orjan Nyland reacts well to snuff out the attack.
79' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Orjan Nyland, who pulls off a stunning save!
79' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the corner.
78' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
78' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Girona force a corner. They send men into the box.
76' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
76' Total attempts – 4:12.
73' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) replacing Ruben Vargas.
71' Substitution. Adria Pedrosa did his best and is replaced by Kike Salas (Sevilla).
70' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
69' That will be all from Oriol Romeu who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
69' Michel decides to make a substitution. Yaser Asprilla will be replaced by Donny van de Beek (Girona).
68' Here comes a substitution. Abel Ruiz is given a rest as he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
66' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
65' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make.
64' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) swings in a cross from the corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga reads it well and gathers the ball.
64' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Sevilla.
63' Arnau Martinez (Girona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
59' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Juan Martinez signals that the goal stands! The Sevilla players celebrate.
59' The goal for Sevilla is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
59' 1 - 1 Goal! Saul Niguez (Sevilla) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.

59' What a great chance for Saul Niguez (Sevilla). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
59' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
57' Paulo Gazzaniga leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
54' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
52' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) plays a one-two with Adria Pedrosa, but the move breaks down.
50' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
50' Sevilla will look to take advantage of the corner kick by scoring.
49' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
48' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Martinez starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Daley Blind (Girona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Yaser Asprilla, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
41' The ball is cleared after Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' The possession of the ball – 62:38.
36' Referee Juan Martinez signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Girona players have a reason to celebrate!
36' Wait! Referee Juan Martinez has indicated he is going to review the Girona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

36' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Arnau Martinez (Girona) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Viktor Tsygankov and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. Orjan Nyland was helpless.
36' David Lopez (Girona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
35' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
33' A short through ball almost allows Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
30' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
28' David Lopez (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
28' The corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is cleared away by the defence.

27' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Abel Ruiz (Girona) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland pulls off a comfortable save.
26' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
23' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.
21' Arnau Martinez (Girona) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
18' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
17' Bryan Gil (Girona) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
16' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
15' A nice individual effort by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
14' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!

13' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the left side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Paulo Gazzaniga, who keeps it out.
13' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
12' Ivan Martin (Girona) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
12' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
9' Half-chance! Bryan Gil (Girona) plays a pass into the box, but Orjan Nyland reacts well to snuff out the attack.
6' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends it out of play.
5' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Bryan Gil (Girona) inside the box.

3' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Paulo Gazzaniga to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
3' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
3' Juan Martinez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Oriol Romeu (Girona) and blew his whistle. A penalty is awarded to Sevilla!
